children: SpaceX (SPCX, Financials), President and Chief Operating Officer Gwynne Shotwell has filed to sell nearly $52 million worth of company stock, adding another notable insider transaction to watch following the company's June IPO.

Shotwell plans to sell 342,170 shares at an implied value of about $151.85 each, according to a Form 144 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The filing lists Morgan Stanley Smith Barney as the broker and Sept. 22 as the approximate sale date.
The shares did not come from an existing position. Shotwell acquired them the same day by exercising stock options and paid for the exercise in cash.

The timing is notable, but the filing also provides important context. The proposed sale is being carried out under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan that Shotwell adopted June 23, allowing insiders to arrange future stock transactions in advance.

Shotwell is both an officer and director of SpaceX. The filing shows roughly 7.70 billion shares outstanding, meaning the proposed transaction represents a small portion of the company's total shares.
The filing also states that Shotwell had not reported any securities sales during the previous three months.
The next catalyst is the completion of the proposed transaction and any additional insider filings as SpaceX settles into life as a public company.

title: SpaceX President Just Filed to Sell Nearly $52 Million in Stock
